clues: This port town sits on a narrow strip of land by a bay in far eastern Russia. It opens the way to a vast inland region rich in gold.
Long, cold winters here are so harsh that the ground stays frozen all year under the town. The cold never lets the soil thaw out fully.
It began in nineteen twenty nine, when men in charge sent prisoners here under Stalin. They ran camps where men were forced to dig for gold.
A big sad mask is kept here to honor those hurt and killed under Stalin. Folks call it the Mask of Sorrow, a name hard to forget.
Holy Trinity Cathedral is a famed sight in this port town in far east Russia. It is one of the town's best known faith sites.
